column1: # p475 first-hand grant reads. HEAD resolved by `git ls-remote --symref`; payload fetched from
# raw.githubusercontent.com at the resolved default branch, written to a file, and the FILE measured.
# PROBE-PATH NOTE: moodle/moodle and frappe/lms BOTH read NO_GRANT on a 5-path probe
# (LICENSE, LICENSE.md, LICENSE.txt, COPYING, LICENCE) and BOTH resolved on a 10-path probe that
# added COPYING.txt and license.txt. The grant was present the whole time; the probe was short.
# DEFAULT-BRANCH NOTE: 6 of 20 repos do NOT default to main/master
# (develop x3, dev x1, v4.0.x-develop x1, master-vs-main varies). A reader that hardcodes
# main/ or master/ in a raw.githubusercontent URL silently 404s and publishes UNGRANTED.
